name: Seared Lemon Shrimp with Tomato Rice Pilaf & Peas

instructions.primary_message: Peel and small dice onions. Peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and garlic; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 3 minutes.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water. Drain rice and transfer to the pot along with the spices. Cook, stirring constantly, about 3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ cups basmati rice
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
½ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add broth and tomato sauce to the pot and bring to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
710 ml chicken or vegetable broth
1 ½ (213 ml) cans tomato sauce

instructions.primary_message: If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 1.02 kg raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the pot, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add shrimp and cook until opaque, 1-2 minutes per side.
While the shrimp cooks, wash, dry, and zest the lemons into a small bowl, then juice it into the same bowl.
Wash, dry, and shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
Remove skillet from the heat and stir in lemon zest, juice, and parsley. Cover with a lid and set aside.
Place peas in a colander and run under hot water (from the tap) to thaw; add to the rice, tossing gently to combine.
To serve, divide rice pilaf and lemon shrimp between plates. Enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen
